facts.fact: A post on opendata.gouv.tg dated 18 December 2024 announces the official launch ceremony on 19 December 2024 of the Open Data and Geoportail Open Data platforms giving access to data on Togo's socio-economic infrastructure; the post carries the MENTD and ATD hashtags but names no policy and no publishing bodies or dataset counts.
